snippet.title: Drawquarium - Deutscher Indie Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Draw your own fish and unlock new ways to decorate your aquarium. If you feed them well, they will gain a metallic shimmer as they age. Will you be the one to raise a golden fish in this relaxing sandbox experience?
